oracle.lint: PY=$(test -x venv/bin/python && echo venv/bin/python || echo conda/python.exe); $PY -m ruff check . --extend-exclude conda,build-tools,darktable-auto-style
oracle.test: PY=$(test -x venv/bin/python && echo venv/bin/python || echo conda/python.exe); $PY -m pytest tests/ -q --tb=short -p no:cacheprovider $(test -f .claude/loop/known-env-failures.txt && sed 's/^/--deselect /' .claude/loop/known-env-failures.txt | tr -d '')
oracle.typecheck: cd client && CI=1 npm run test
oracle.build: cd client && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.spec.json && npx ng lint && npm run build
